test_title: PYST 56: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 12 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

The list of subjects to be discussed at a meeting
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 3'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**Agenda**" refers to the list of subjects or topics to be discussed in a meeting.

Hence, the correct answer is 'Option 3'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "Minutes" refers to the record of what was discussed or decided in a meeting, not the list of subjects beforehand.
 
• **Option 2:** "Objectives" refer to the goals or aims but not the specific list of discussion topics for a meeting.
 
• **Option 4:** "Menu" refers to a list of food items, not meeting topics.
